newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait firm raises stake in Burgan.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait firm raises stake in Burgan.

text.p: Kuwait Investment Projects Company raised its stake in Burgan Bank to 22 percent by purchasing 15 million shares for 4.4 million dinars ($14.8 million), banking executives said on Tuesday.

Burgan on Monday auctioned 20.79 million shares which the Kuwait Stock Exchange said were issued to investors who failed to pay for them. Only 16.5 million shares were sold at the starting price of 295 fils ($0.98).
Three private investros bought 500,000 shares each.
The owners of the shares published a warning in local newspapers to potential buyers that the 20.79 million shares were being disputed in Kuwaiti courts in five lawsuits.
Burgan, in which the state holds a majority stake, has a total of 743.4 million shares.
The bank made a 90.5 percent profit rise to seven million dinars in the first half of 1996 compared to the same period in 1995.
